name: Representatives
description: The AI personas that act for a person or a team. A Representative carries the person's authority, preferences and quality profile into every request, and the sub-goals of that request carry the same authority.
purpose: Let an AI act for a person the way that person would want, within the authority the person gave: the worker categories allowed, the data scope (whose data the AI may read), the person's asking policy and quality profile.
approach: Give each representative the person's judgment about asking and the person's feedback.
out_of_scope: Deciding when to ask (Judgment Calls does that), learning from feedback (Feedback Learning does that) and translating implied priorities (Prioritization does that).
milestones: 1. A representative acts as its person would want (metric-the-representatives).
measures_of_success: A representative acts as its person would want.
outputs: The person's authority, preferences and quality profile for a request.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Feedback Learning
description: Applies a person's feedback to specs and metrics, and never to prompts, so a correction given once is followed afterwards without every task's instructions growing. It proposes quality profile changes, which ESOI Application applies as spec and metric edits.
purpose: Make a correction given once change behaviour afterwards: propose edits to specs and metrics, which ESOI Application applies directly unless Judgment Calls decides to ask.
approach: Record each piece of feedback against what it corrected and adjust the behaviour it concerns.
out_of_scope: Applying the edit (ESOI Application does that), deciding the profile the person prefers (Representatives own it) and the thresholds for asking (Judgment Calls owns them).
milestones: 1. A correction given once is followed afterwards (metric-feedback-learning).
measures_of_success: A correction given once is followed afterwards.
outputs: Proposed edits to specs and metrics.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Judgment Calls
description: Decides, for one person, whether to ask, proceed or decline when the Nervous System raises a risk signal. The decision may go to a human, to another agent or to a delegate. It shares one signal contract with the Nervous System.
purpose: Ask a person only when that person would want to be asked, and decide how: whether the ask blocks or waits, whether it is batched, what may continue meanwhile, and whether a change to specs or a learning step needs an ask at all (by default it does not).
approach: Take a risk signal with its severity and reason, decide per person, and let feedback move the thresholds.
out_of_scope: Raising the risk signal (the Nervous System does that) and learning the person's thresholds from feedback (Feedback Learning does that).
milestones: 1. The decision matches what the person would have chosen (metric-judgment-calls).
measures_of_success: The decision matches what the person would have chosen.
inputs: A risk signal with its severity and reason, and the person.
outputs: One decision for one person: ask, proceed or decline, and who is asked.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Human Prioritization
description: Translates a person's priorities, which are sometimes only subtly specified or implied, into ESOI: milestones, metric weights and quality profile weights. ESOI is the structure in which prioritization is carried out. It works with Critical Thinking, Representatives and Guidance.
purpose: Turn the priorities a person implies into ESOI.
approach: Do the one job of the solution by the best-measured implementation.
out_of_scope: Carrying the person's preferences (Representatives do that), turning a request into a metric (Metric Translation does that) and long-term nudges (Guidance does that).
milestones: 1. The weights the system derives match the priorities the person confirms (authoritative metric metric-human-prioritization).
measures_of_success: The weights the system derives match the priorities the person confirms.
inputs: A person, a request and what the person implied.
outputs: Priorities as ESOI milestones and weights.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Request Intake
description: Takes in the requests people make from every source Body declares and attaches each to the person who made it, so the rest of the flow can ask for that person's Representative.
purpose: Take in every request a person makes, once, from wherever the system listens.
approach: Do the one job of the solution by the best-measured implementation.
out_of_scope: Where requests come from (Body's Intake Sources define the adapters), answering them (the flow does that) and what each person is allowed (Representatives do that).
milestones: 1. Take in every request a person makes, once, from wherever the system listens. (authoritative metric metric-request-intake).
measures_of_success: Take in every request a person makes, once, from wherever the system listens.
inputs: Which sources to read, and optionally one person.
outputs: A list of requests, each with its text, person and source.
effects: Reads the sources through Intake Sources and takes each request out of its source so it is handed over once.
